features.title: Trend weight EWMA over irregular gaps
steps: Add a trend-weight calculation to StezuCore. Input: dated weigh-ins on irregular days. Output: the trend on each weigh-in day.
The first weigh-in seeds the trend. For a gap of d days the new weigh-in gets weight 1 - (1 - alpha)^d, with alpha configurable (default 0.1 per day).
Days without a weigh-in are absent, not zero, and do not update the trend.
Return a confidence with the trend, based on how many weigh-ins it rests on and how recent they are.

features.title: Expenditure estimate
steps: Add an expenditure estimate: mean logged intake over the last 21 days minus (trend change over those days x 3500 kcal/lb) / 21.
Exclude partial days: logged intake under 50% of that week's typical (median) intake.
Return insufficient data, never 0, when the window lacks intake or trend data.
Return a confidence with the estimate.

features.title: Weekly calorie target rule
steps: Add the weekly target rule from SPEC.md with all thresholds configurable.
Return insufficient data and no change with fewer than 4 weigh-ins in the week or fewer than 21 days of data.
Raise the target by the configured step (100 to 150 kcal) when the 3-week trend rate is more than 0.15 lb/week under the target rate; lower it by 100 kcal when it is more than 0.25 lb/week over.
Allow at most one change per week, and return the reason and a confidence with every result.

features.title: Protein floor flag
steps: Add a protein floor check over a 3-day rolling mean of daily protein.
Use the low end of each meal's estimate range.
The floor is a configurable parameter; tests use synthetic values.
With fewer than 3 days of logged food return insufficient data, not a flag.

features.title: Home screen three cards from a view model
steps: Add a HomeViewModel that produces the Data, Food and Workout cards (label, subtitle, value text) from core values.
Time of day picks the inverted card; inject the clock.
Missing values render as --, never 0.
HomeView renders the view model's cards with the DESIGN.md tokens.

features.title: HealthKit body-mass read behind the HealthStore protocol
steps: Define a HealthStore protocol in StezuCore with an async read of body-mass samples, plus a FakeHealthStore for tests.
Implement the protocol in the app with HealthKit, read-only body mass. Needs approval: HealthKit entitlement and capability.
Denied authorization or no samples is absent data, not zero.

features.title: One-tap weigh-in write
steps: Add a body-mass write to the HealthStore protocol; the fake records writes.
The weigh-in control is prefilled from the last weigh-in and adjusted without a keyboard; one tap writes the sample.
Needs approval: HealthKit write access.

features.title: Workout session model with last-session numbers and a rest timer
steps: Add a workout session model: exercises, sets (weight and reps) and a one-call log-set operation.
Expose the last session's numbers for each exercise; absent when there is no previous session.
Add a rest timer driven by an injected clock.

features.title: Double-progression rule
steps: Add a double-progression suggestion: add reps within the rep range, then add weight once every set reaches the top of the range.
Rep range and weight step are configurable.
No suggestion without a last session (absent, not zero).

features.title: Dining menu models and client against a VM endpoint
steps: Add Codable models for dining menus (FoodPro) as served by a VM endpoint.
Add a client that takes an injected transport protocol, so core needs no networking import and tests need no network.
Use a synthetic fixture. An unavailable menu is absent, not an empty menu.
Needs approval: the endpoint URL and token handling.
